title: Reliquary Landmark
description: Synchronized companion to the landmark declaration (docs/spec/landmarks.md), which remains normative. One authored JSON5 kind, .rlql: one declaration owning the geometry — pinned screen dimensions, a region list and a named spot set — with its renderings attached as plain PNGs beside it by stem-and-number adjacency (<name>.1.png, <name>.2.png), never listed here. Schema validity never implies document validity: the bounds checks (a region or spot outside the pinned screen), the requirement that at least one variant rendering exist, the refusal of a variant whose decoded dimensions differ from the pinned ones, and the exclusive (0%, 100%) similarity range all live in the specification and the parser only. It validates the parsed document; the JSON5 grammar (comments, trailing commas, unquoted keys) is invisible at this level. Documents carry no $schema field pre-1.0; editors bind this schema to *.rlql by file association.

screen.description: The screen dimensions every variant rendering shares. Pinned, and mode is deliberately absent: the guest's video mode is observable over no control plane, and a field nothing can check is a declaration Reliquary would have to take on faith.

regions.description: Modifiers over the whole-screen exact match. Optional: a bare landmark matches the entire screen pixel for pixel.

spots.description: Named points in screen coordinates. Declared and validated today, and unread until the pointer verbs land: a spotless landmark is watchable and not clickable.

region.description: One rectangle and what it does to its own pixels. An ignore region excludes them outright and wins where regions overlap; a fuzzy region judges them against its own declared percentage. Everything no region covers requires 100%.

allOf.description: A fuzzy region states its own similarity; there is no default.
An ignore region judges none of its pixels, so a similarity on one is a contradiction rather than a redundancy.

percent.description: A percent literal with its unit spelled, as durations spell theirs. The spelling is all this checks: the exclusive (0%, 100%) range — 0% being an ignore region in a second spelling and 100% the region's absence — is a numeric comparison a pattern cannot make honestly, so it is the parser's, like the bounds checks above.

spot.description: One point on the pinned screen.
